statusHistory.note: FOODIE-9000 byline. Sourced from near-sources-war-room's 2026-09-07 NYC seeding pass (trust: auto, independently corroborated by Greenpointers, Shelf Awareness, North Brooklyn Dispatch). Google Maps confirms open and operating (4.8 stars, 140 reviews, wheelchair accessible), owners identified on the listing as Black-owned, woman-owned, Latinx-owned, family-owned. Research floor: near-deep-researcher cross-referenced the three press sources plus the venue's own site and Instagram; Reddit (r/nycbookstores, r/AskNYC) mentions are sparse but positive, mostly directing people to the soup; Google reviews (140, recent, 4.8 average) repeatedly cite the reading nooks, the pull-out stage in back, and the Edgar Allan Poetry Corner as the specific draws, with no negative pattern found. Five preferred-sources context check: Greenpointers, Shelf Awareness, North Brooklyn Dispatch, and general NYC bookstore coverage from TikTok/secretnyc and Yelp all corroborate.
